review.body_prefix:
**Current-head assessment:** Compared with the main commit merged into this branch, the intended change is one central package declaration: Microsoft.Windows.ImplementationLibrary 1.0.250325.1 -> 1.0.260126.7. It remains separate from the structural dependency consolidation discussed in #51324.

The five central PackageReference consumers are runner, CliShim, MeasureToolCore, PowerRenameUI and Microsoft.CommandPalette.Extensions. Of the 39 separate legacy packages.config declarations, 38 already use 1.0.260126.7; FileExplorerDllExporter retains its older explicit pin and is unchanged by this central update. That exception does not create a new dependency change in that project.

**Validation scope:** An exact-head x64 Release build of CliShim and its project references passed, and its resolved assets select WIL 1.0.260126.7. This is a focused native-consumer check, not a full build of all five consumers, ARM64 execution or an unconditional runtime approval. The larger build described in the PR remains attributed to the author.

No additional demonstrated code defect is asserted. The current automated review returned zero inline comments but included a startup-timeout warning, so this summary does not represent a fresh full-review clean approval. The PR's older comparison base also displays merged-main changes outside the intended version bump; those unrelated changes are not treated here as newly introduced UI or telemetry work.
